edits.old: Check the proposed conditions in both directions. Could information outside the chosen interpretation qualify through one alternative or relationship? Could information covered by the chosen interpretation be excluded by them?
edits.new: Check the proposed definition as a whole, including its opening description and every alternative or relationship. Are its conditions enough to establish membership, or can something satisfy the wording while lacking a defining feature of the chosen kind? Could a member of the chosen interpretation fail the wording?
